result.instructions: Venti is a free app for paraglider pilots. This connector answers from public data the Venti server holds: wind measured by weather stations, airspace, flying sites (OpenStreetMap's, those of Venti's partners, and on request the places from pilots, which are not official), and the flights pilots made public. Give places as coordinates. Say how old a reading is, name the source of the data and pass on each source's licence and notice. Airspace answers are advice from data that is not certified and never a clearance: nothing here knows what is active today. A site is not permission to fly there. Those tools are open to everyone and know nothing about the person asking. Three more read one pilot's own logbook on Venti, the private flights too: logbook_statistics, list_flights and get_flight. They work only after that pilot has signed in on Venti's own page and agreed, and they only read. What they return is that pilot's own: use it to answer the pilot, and do not pass it on to anyone else unasked.
